summary.tldr: Sets rules provinces must meet to receive federal cash transfers for mental health, addictions and substance use services.
what_it_does: Creates criteria a province must meet for a full federal cash contribution for mental health, addictions and substance use services under the Canada Health Transfer.
Requires provincial plans to cover all insured mental health, addictions and substance use services and to meet rules on public administration, universality, portability and accessibility.
Prohibits full cash contributions if a province allows extra-billing or user charges for these services, with a limited exception for certain hospital accommodation or meals.
Allows the Minister and Governor in Council to reduce or withhold cash contributions when a province fails the criteria or conditions, after notice, consultation and reporting steps.
Amends the Federal-Provincial Fiscal Arrangements Act to add the new act to the federal transfer rules and related deduction and reimbursement provisions.
summary.background: It builds on the Canada Health Transfer and the Federal-Provincial Fiscal Arrangements Act.
